🎙️ Luciano Spalletti’s #JuveVenezia press conference: • Kalulu and Nico González will not be available. • Conceição will be assessed. Sooner or later, he’ll be back on the pitch. • Woltemade feels comfortable playing in his new role. I’m convinced he’ll succeed. • Ekhator is an important prospect. I hope he continues improving his physical condition. • I really don’t understand why there’s so much fuss about Zidane and Conte’s comments. • I’m preparing for this 600th match with exactly the same excitement I felt before my first. • Spoke to McKennie after his interview, I didn’t get the impression that he wanted to leave. • Gatti is trying to add something more to his game beyond simply defending. • We’ll face a side that plays very vertically. As soon as they regain possession, they immediately look to attack the space behind the opposition.
"Kalulu and Nico Gonzalez will not be with us tomorrow. Despite this, we have had two good training sessions." 🚨 🗣️ Luciano Spalletti

Spalletti has decided in recent matches to move Randal Kolo Muani out on the wing, a decision has proved fruitful to the manager thus far. The Frenchman isn’t a traditional number nine and needs to move, to attack space to take advantage of his athleticism. (Gazzetta_it )

JUVENTUS LEGENDS TO REUNITE IN TURIN FOR A SPECIAL TRIBUTE TO GIANLUCA VIALLI 🕊️ ❤️ On 9 January 2027, the legendary Juventus squad of the 1995/96 season will return to the pitch for a special evening dedicated to the memory of Gianluca Vialli. The event will take place at the Inalpi Arena in Turin, bringing together some of the most iconic players from that unforgettable Juventus generation. Among those expected to participate are Alessandro Del Piero, Fabrizio Ravanelli, Angelo Peruzzi, Ciro Ferrara, Angelo Di Livio, Alessio Tacchinardi and more! The evening will also serve an important charitable purpose, with the Fondazione Vialli e Mauro involved in the initiative. 🤍 🖤

‼️ 🇳🇱 Juventus CEO Giovanni Carnevali is considering making a move for Lazio midfielder Kenneth Taylor, as the Bianconeri continue to explore potential midfield reinforcements. The 24-year-old Dutch international has emerged as another interesting option for Juventus as the management evaluates ways to strengthen Luciano Spalletti’s squad. Taylor’s technical ability, tactical intelligence and versatility in midfield could make him an attractive addition to the Bianconeri. The Dutchman offers several qualities that could benefit Juventus: • Excellent technical ability and ball distribution. • Ability to operate in multiple midfield roles. • Intelligent movement and attacking contributions. • Experience at European and international level. • Significant potential for further development. ‼️ 🇩🇰 Juventus are working on a January deal for Pierre-Emile Højbjerg. The proposed formula is a loan with an option or conditional obligation to buy in June 2027, with a total valuation of around €15 million. The main obstacle is Marseille's demand for financial guarantees, as the French club would prefer to receive payment immediately. Højbjerg is attracted by the prospect of playing in Serie A, which could help Juventus find an agreement. 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — Gazzetta_it
